Existing US companies can still have `business_type: "llc"`. The new list has no matching option, so the controlled `Select` appears blank while the form state stays truthy. The save check accepts `llc`, and `US_COMPANY_STRUCTURES` sends no structure. Treat a value missing from the active list as unset and require the seller to choose the LLC member count.

The new list has no matching option, so the controlled `Select` appears blank while the form state stays truthy. The save check accepts `llc`, and `US_COMPANY_STRUCTURES` sends no structure. Treat a value missing from the active list as unset and require the seller to choose the LLC member count. --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````
